title: Taylor-Melcher Leaky Dielectric Interfacial Dynamics
summary: Investigating electrohydrodynamic droplet deformations governed by the competition between charge relaxation time ($t_e = \varepsilon/\sigma$) and hydrodynamic deformation time ($t_h = \mu a / \gamma$). Our work reveals non-linear quadrupolar recirculating flow structures and explains prolate-to-oblate transitions under AC and pulsed DC electric fields.
affiliation: In Collaboration with Prof. Aditya Bandopadhyay
